200.name: paint
200.docs:
Appends the glyphs, as laid out by the last [`Self::measure`], to `scene`
with their top-left corner at `origin`.

137.name: TextLine
137.docs: One line of a broken [`TextLayout`], as reported by [`TextLayout::lines`].

99.name: new
99.docs: Creates a text system with Inter registered and used for every generic family.

136.name: lines
136.docs:
The lines of the last [`Self::measure`], with their text ranges and
positions (documents and PDF export draw text line by line).

10.name: fold
10.docs:
Folds a character to what searches compare: lowercase, without accents, so
"regiao" finds "Região". Folding can change how many characters there are.

98.name: TextSystem
98.docs: Font database plus reusable layout scratch space. Create one per app.

224.name: ravenrs_text
224.docs:
Text shaping and layout for RavenRS.

[`TextSystem`] owns Parley's font database and scratch space. It ships with
Inter (SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `fonts/Inter-LICENSE.txt`) embedded,
because browsers expose no system fonts to WebAssembly; the same bytes are used
on the desktop so text looks identical everywhere. System fonts are not loaded.

Layout happens in logical pixels. The renderer rasterizes glyphs at the device
scale factor, so text stays sharp on HiDPI screens without re-shaping.

47.name: into
47.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

198.name: broken_at
198.docs: The width limit of the last line breaking, to skip redundant work.

9.name: inter_font
9.docs:
The embedded Inter font file, regular or semibold, for documents that embed
the font they were measured with.

134.name: baseline
134.docs: Baseline, from the top of the layout.

133.name: top
133.docs: Top of the line box, from the top of the layout.

7.name: builtin_font
7.docs: A built-in font by its [`builtin_font_number`], for drawing shaped glyphs back.

107.name: layout_ellipsized
107.docs:
Shapes `text` on one line, cut at a character boundary and ended with
`…` so it fits `max_width`. Text that already fits comes back whole.

132.name: width
132.docs: Width of the line's content, trailing whitespace excluded.

18.name: TextAttrs
18.docs: Visual attributes of a piece of text.

169.name: ShapedGlyph
169.docs: One glyph of a [`TextLayout`], as reported by [`TextLayout::glyphs`].

106.name: TextLayout
106.docs: Shaped text, ready to be broken into lines at any width and drawn.

5.name: builtin_font_number
5.docs:
Which built-in font these bytes are, as a number that does not change between
runs: what a recording stores instead of the font itself.

168.name: glyphs
168.docs:
The glyphs of the last [`Self::measure`] in visual order, with the text
each one stands for (document exporters embed glyphs, not characters).

105.name: layout
105.docs: Shapes `text`. Line breaking happens later in [`TextLayout::measure`].

130.name: range
130.docs: Byte range of the line in the source text, trailing whitespace included.

4.name: DEFAULT_FAMILY
4.docs: The family name of the embedded default font.

16.name: family
16.docs: Font family list in CSS syntax; defaults to the embedded Inter.

167.name: text
167.docs: Byte range of the source text this glyph's cluster stands for.

104.name: measure
104.docs: Breaks lines at `max_width` (or never, for `None`) and returns the text's size.

3.name: ICON_FAMILY
3.docs: The family name of the embedded icon font.

15.name: letter_spacing
15.docs: Extra space between characters in logical pixels; may be negative.

166.name: advance
166.docs: How far the next glyph advances.

103.name: register_font
103.docs: Registers a font file (TTF/OTF/TTC) and returns the family names it provides.

2.name: RAVEN_ICONS
2.docs: A subset of Lucide icons (ISC License), see `scripts/gen-icons.py`.

165.name: x
165.docs: Horizontal position, from the left of the layout.

164.name: id
164.docs: The glyph's index in the font.
